services_heading: Tree Surgery Services Across Leeds and West Yorkshire
services_subhead: From routine pruning to complex felling, we deliver safe, professional arboricultural work with full insurance cover.

services.title: Tree Felling
services.desc: Safe and controlled removal of large or dangerous trees. We dismantle and remove all debris, leaving your garden clear. Perfect for diseased, dead or overhanging trees.

services.title: Crown Reduction
services.desc: Reduce the size and weight of mature trees whilst maintaining their natural shape. Ideal for improving light, preventing storm damage and protecting neighbouring properties.

services.title: Crown Thinning
services.desc: Selective removal of branches to allow more light through the canopy. Improves air flow, reduces wind resistance and keeps your garden feeling open.

services.title: Stump Grinding
services.desc: Remove unsightly stumps completely using professional grinding equipment. Reclaim your garden space and prevent regrowth within hours.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Reduction
services.desc: Keep boundary hedges tidy and safe. We handle everything from routine cutting to major reductions and removal of overgrown or diseased hedges.

services.title: Emergency Tree Works
services.desc: Storm damage, hanging branches or fallen trees? We respond within 24 hours to make your property safe. Available 7 days a week.

about_pullquote: We do the job right so you don't have to worry about safety or mess.
about_para_1: Simon Roberts Tree Surgeons was established over 18 years ago with one mission: to deliver professional, honest arboricultural work to homeowners and businesses across Leeds and West Yorkshire. We're NPTC certified, fully insured and equipped to handle everything from routine pruning to complex felling operations. Every team member undergoes ongoing training to stay ahead of best practice and safety regulations.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up on time, doing the work properly and leaving your garden cleaner than we found it. We don't cut corners or upsell unnecessary work — we assess what your trees actually need and quote accordingly. Homeowners and property managers across the region trust us because we listen first, explain everything and deliver results that speak for themselves.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Our Tree Work

reviews.text: Needed an old oak tree removed before it damaged the garage. Simon came out, did a free survey, quoted fair and was back within a week. The crew worked quickly, safely and left the garden spotless. Brilliant job. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Storm brought down a neighbour's tree across our fence. Called Simon at 8am, they were here by noon and had it cleared by late afternoon. Professional, efficient, and they even repaired some fence panels. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Jennifer P.

reviews.text: Crown reduction on a massive beech was daunting but Simon explained everything clearly. Watched them work — no damage to the garden, no mess left behind. The tree looks healthier already and now we get proper light. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: David K.
